versions.changelog:
proxima-vps-setup v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for set up, repair, or documentation of Proxima deployments on remote Ubuntu VPS.
- Provides workflow guidance for safe, SSH-tunneled GUI/VNC/REST exposure, non-root user setup, and internal-only binding.
- Includes step-by-step workflow for verifying each layer of deployment, troubleshooting, and validating access and service status.
- Emphasizes best practices and operational risk warnings.
- References server, security, local-access, and troubleshooting documentation for thorough procedure coverage.
